title: Homeomorphism after base change
statement: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], let $k\to k\prime$ be a field extension, and let $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a separated, locally finite type, quasi-compact morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with $\dim |C|\le0$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Put $C_{k\prime}=C\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k\prime$ and let $\pi:C_{k\prime}\to C$ be the projection [def-pc-base-change]. The continuous map $|\pi|:|C_{k\prime}|\to|C|$ is a homeomorphism.

source.place: Tags 00KH and 00P4 for discrete spaces; schemes.tex Tag 01JT for bijectivity; elementary discrete-space topology

proof.text: Use geometry for DiscreteTopology C. The base change is locally Noetherian by LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian; use the topology ingredient and IsLocallyArtinian.of_topologicalKrullDim_le_zero for discrete topology of the source.

The point ingredient gives surjectivity by existence and injectivity by uniqueness in each fibre. The scheme projection is continuous. In a discrete target every image of an open set is open, so this bijection is an IsHomeomorph.
Assemble continuity, the open-map proof using isOpen_discrete, injectivity, and surjectivity into IsHomeomorph.
